summary: Representative-elect Micah Lasher has acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI, without describing it as a threat of extinction. In an October 2026 op-ed Lasher warned that we may soon face "the moment of gravest danger" in AI's development and that big AI companies press on, "risks to civilization notwithstanding". Lasher has also called for treaties to minimize superintelligence risks.
